title: Genomic DNA extraction from Mycobacterium avium
author: Tetsuya Komatsu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bupvnvn6

steps.title: Resuspend colonies and wash
steps.instruction: Process the harvested colonies through a series of suspensions and centrifugations.

substeps.instruction: Suspend colonies from 7H11 agar in 300 µl TE.
Centrifuge at 5,000 g for 10 min.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 300 µl acetone.
Centrifuge at 5,000 g for 10 min.
Discard acetone and resuspend pellet in 200 µl TE.
Add lysozyme to a final concentration of 100 µg ml⁻¹.
Incubate at 37 °C overnight.
Add proteinase K to a final concentration of 0.2 mg ml⁻¹.
Incubate at 50 °C for 3 h.
Add 1/10 volume of 3 M sodium acetate (NaOAc).
Add an equal volume of phenol/chloroform/isoamyl‑alcohol and shake vigorously.
Centrifuge at 12,000 g for 10 min.
Transfer the aqueous (upper) phase to a new tube.

steps.title: DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate DNA from the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 2‑propanol.
Centrifuge at 12,000 g for 10 min.
Discard supernatant and wash the pellet with 70 % ethanol.
Resuspend the pellet in 400 µl TE.
Add RNase to a final concentration of 100 µg ml⁻¹.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Repeat extraction and precipitation
steps.instruction: Perform a second phenol‑chloroform extraction and precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 50 °C for 3 h (as in step 3).
Add 1/10 volume of 3 M NaOAc.
Add an equal volume of phenol/chloroform/isoamyl‑alcohol and shake vigorously.
Centrifuge at 12,000 g for 10 min.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube.
Add an equal volume of 2‑propanol.
Centrifuge at 12,000 g for 10 min.
Discard supernatant and wash the pellet with 70 % ethanol.
